request:
Preserve native Agent failure diagnostics

## Problem

GitWeave currently collects provider-native failure events and stderr, but often replaces the visible failure message with a generic runtime message:

```text
Agent did not complete successfully
```

This hides the concrete diagnostic that Codex or Claude already produced.

It makes GitWeave less transparent than invoking the underlying CLI directly and adds unnecessary normalization policy.

## Expected outcome

Preserve the provider's actual failure diagnostic when an Agent Node fails.

Prefer the most relevant native machine-readable error/event when available, otherwise preserve stderr or another provider-native diagnostic.

Conceptually:

```text
Codex / Claude failure
  ↓
GitWeave records native events and stderr
  ↓
Runtime Failure exposes the real diagnostic
```

Do not replace concrete provider errors with a generic GitWeave message unless no useful native diagnostic exists.

Keep raw provider events in provenance as today.

## Context

The guiding principle is:

> GitWeave should not hide useful native CLI behavior behind its own generic policy.

This is the Agent-side equivalent of preserving real Git diagnostics in #39.


User directive: GitWeave implements, creates a separate PR, reviews/fixes iteratively and merges only when clean. Stop on unsupported operations or permission/allowance limits and ask the user. No parent manual substitute is authorized.
